verdict.rationale: Generating and publishing API documentation is a fair question for an API client like Hoppscotch, but the evidence pack shows no documented documentation-generation or publishing feature. The Embed feature (docs-5) is an adjacent interactive request widget, not generated docs. A community user notes the product "can't create documentation for a folder/request."

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate and publish API documentation from my collections or specs
